title: Influence bound for polynomial threshold functions
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a polynomial threshold function of degree at most $k$: some real-valued function $p$ on the Boolean cube has Fourier degree at most $k$, and $f(x)$ is $1$ when $p(x)\\ge 0$ and $-1$ otherwise. Then the total influence of $f$ is at most $2n^{1-2^{-k}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ signs
$f$ is represented by thresholding a real-valued function
the representing function has Fourier degree at most $k$
